parts.name: Fund vs. founders
parts.rule: Bad events are measured as a share of companies backed. Under 1% costs nothing. A missing portfolio count is not scored as a 70% rate. −3 per case the fund lost or where fraud was found.

inputs.name: Lawsuits with its own startups or founders
inputs.why: 1 case ÷ 450 = 0.22%. The denominator is a published floor, so this rate is an upper bound. Under 1%, no penalty.

inputs.name: Pushing out founder CEOs
inputs.why: No removal was verified as its own event. Where a lawsuit alleged one, it stays inside that lawsuit.

inputs.name: Down-round or pay-to-play behavior
inputs.why: No evidence found. Terms were not checked, so coverage is 0% and there is no deduction.

inputs.name: Blocking acquisitions or rounds
inputs.why: No documented veto was verified on its own. Coverage is 0%.

inputs.name: Lost case or fraud finding (−3 each)

parts.name: Ability to support you
parts.rule: Money 6 + media 6 (capped) + help after the check 5.5. Claims the fund makes about itself count at half until founders confirm them. Partner departures cost −0.5 for each calendar year with a departure, up to −2.

inputs.name: Money
inputs.why: Fund size 2/2: Form ADV Item 5.F discretionary regulatory AUM is $20,239,213,324. Money left 1.5/2: reserves are not in the filing. Hit target 1.5/2: no published target for the current fund.

inputs.name: Media reach (capped)
inputs.why: No measured audience. Owned channels were not scored.

inputs.name: Help after the check
inputs.why: Platform 1/2: the firm's own claim, scored at half. Intros 0.75/1.5: the firm's own claim, scored at half. Partner stability 2/2: no departure year was verified for this adviser.

parts.name: Founder experience
parts.rule: Only first-hand accounts count. If negative accounts are under 1% of the portfolio, or there are none, the fund gets its age default.

inputs.name: First-hand accounts
inputs.why: None collected. Anonymous and second-hand posts were not used.

inputs.name: Negative share
inputs.why: No negative first-hand account, so the share is under 1%.

parts.name: Conflicts of interest
parts.rule: −1 per documented conflict, scaled by partner count. No documented conflict was scored here.

inputs.name: Documented conflicts
inputs.why: None verified. Board seats were not censused.

parts.name: Track record bonus
parts.rule: +1 for every 5 years of investing with no significant pattern of harm, up to +3.

inputs.name: Years investing
inputs.why: Bessemer's own history says the venture firm dates to 1975. The 1911 date is the Phipps family office, not this adviser. 51 ÷ 5 is capped at +3.

parts.name: Regulatory penalty
parts.rule: Penalty only. A fine is −10 to −20. A clean Form ADV disclosure page is 0. Sanctions need an exact identity match.

inputs.name: SEC record
inputs.why: No information filed on the disclosure pages of the May 13, 2026 Form ADV.

inputs.name: Sanctions
inputs.why: No sanctions designation in the Form ADV. People were not screened one by one.

summary: Bessemer publishes 450+ active portfolio companies and, on its homepage, claims a talent team and a large intro practice. Those claims are scored at half. One 2011 founder-company suit is on the legal record.

takeaways.title: The homepage support claims are scored at half.
takeaways.text: Talent advisors, operating advisors, and “1,000+ introductions a year” are Bessemer’s own words.

matters.text: Transeo, owned by founder Laurent Marteau, sued Bessemer entities after Bessemer took control of Neutral Holdings. The March 29, 2013 opinion dismissed the CEO-removal fiduciary claim and let a refusal-to-consider-an-offer claim proceed. A final judgment was not found.

rules.title: How Regretamine score works
rules.body: Every fund starts with full points and loses them only for verified evidence about its own behavior. Bad events are a share of the portfolio: under 1% costs nothing. A missing portfolio count is not treated as a 70% rate. Regulatory is penalty-only.
